name: Akkhara
blurb: Akkhara is a multilingual dictionary designed to enhance the way you explore and understand languages.
description:
Akkhara is a multilingual dictionary designed to enhance the way you explore and understand languages.
It aims to be more than a simple dictionary by acting as a linguistic companion for language enthusiasts,
students, professionals, and casual users alike.

Key features include:

• Comprehensive word database

• Multilingual support

• Keyword search and in-definition word search

• Approximative keyword search (fuzzy search)

• Multi-dictionary search

• Offline access

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
